sources.title: BLIP · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapped Language-Image Pretraining) is a vision-language pretraining (VLP) framework designed for both understanding and generation tasks. Most existing pretrained models are only good at one or the other. It uses a captioner to generate captions and a filter to remove the noisy captions. This increases training data quality and more effectively uses the messy web data.

sources.title: Understanding BLIP : A Huggingface Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) is a multimodal AI model that combines computer vision and natural language processing to understand both images and text together. It is trained on large-scale image-text pairs, enabling strong performance in vision-language tasks.
